description: This file provides wrapper functions for syscfg configurations, including initialization, commit, get, and set operations. It facilitates interaction with the syscfg library, encapsulating common syscfg functions.

methods.name: int SyscfgInit()
methods.description: Initializes the syscfg subsystem by calling syscfg_init().

methods.name: int SyscfgCommit()
methods.description: Commits pending syscfg changes by calling syscfg_commit().

methods.name: int SyscfgGet(const char * name,char * value,int size)
methods.description: Retrieves a syscfg value for a given name into the provided buffer.

methods.name: int SyscfgSet(const char * name,const char * value)
methods.description: Sets a syscfg value for a given name and commits the change.

ctags.name: SyscfgGet
ctags.pattern: /^int SyscfgGet(const char * name, char * value, int size)$/

ctags.name: SyscfgSet
ctags.pattern: /^int SyscfgSet(const char * name, const char * value)$/
